units.source_text: 槿姬并非不识源氏公子风度之优美与情感之丰富。

en.t: Princess Asagao was by no means unaware of Prince Genji's graceful bearing and rich feeling.

units.source_text: 但她认为：如果向他表示好感，势必被他看作与世间一般夸赞他的女子同等模样，

en.t: But she thought that if she showed him any favor, he would surely regard her as no different from the ordinary women of the world who praised him,

units.source_text: 且我这轻飘的内心必将被她看穿，又觉可耻。

en.t: and he would certainly see through her own frivolous heart, which made her feel ashamed.

units.source_text: 所以对他万万不可表示爱慕。

en.t: Therefore she must never show him any sign of love.

units.source_text: 她只能在收到来信时作无关紧要的复信，保持不即不离的关系。

en.t: When she received a letter, she could only send back an inconsequential reply and maintain a relationship that was neither close nor distant.

units.source_text: 或者当他来访时叫侍女传言答话，但求不失礼貌。

en.t: Or when he came to visit, she would have a maid answer through a message, seeking only not to be discourteous.

units.source_text: 她自念近年来怠于佛事，常思出家修行，以赎罪愆。

en.t: She reflected that in recent years she had neglected Buddhist observances, and she often thought of taking vows and practicing religious discipline to atone for her sins.

units.source_text: 但倘在此时立刻出家，和他决绝，则又类似情场失意的行径，势必惹起世人纷纷议论。

en.t: But if she were to take vows at once and break with him at this moment, it would look like the conduct of someone disappointed in love and would surely stir up endless gossip.

units.source_text: 她深知人言可畏，所以非常小心，对身边的侍女也不泄露真情。

en.t: She knew well how frightening people's talk could be, so she was extremely careful and did not reveal her true feelings even to the maids near her.

units.source_text: 只在自己心中秘密打算，逐渐准备修行之事。

en.t: She only made her plans secretly within her own heart and gradually prepared for a life of religious practice.

units.source_text: 她有许多兄弟，但皆非同母，一向疏远。

en.t: She had many brothers, but none shared the same mother, and they had always been distant from her.

units.source_text: 近来他们这宫邸里境况日渐萧条。

en.t: Lately, conditions in their princely residence had grown more desolate day by day.

units.source_text: 当此之时，有源氏公子那样的红人诚恳地上门来求爱，

en.t: At such a time, a favorite of the age like Prince Genji came earnestly to the residence to seek her love,

units.source_text: 邸内的人无不巴望其成功，几乎都同源氏公子一条心。

en.t: and everyone in the residence longed for his success, almost sharing the same wish as Prince Genji himself.
